note: Vessel waypoints for sweeps_soft.py (format: its docstring). Anatomy is data: each entry cites its sources and says what is derived and what is schematic. Written by CP-1+ (first pass, to be vetted): every course between waypoints is a straight chart segment, every point is `inferred`, and the radii are stated defaults.

s.anterior-ethmoidal-septal-branch.L.variable: Entry depends on the turbinate's axilla, which the specimen approximates with the turbinate head.
s.anterior-ethmoidal-septal-branch.L.derivation: Entry: A = A(lm.middle-turbinate-head.L) - 7.35 = -12.21 - 7.35 = -19.56 (Gras-Cabrerizo 2016, 7.35 mm behind the septal projection of the middle turbinate head, mean of 10 cavities); height: S = top(a) - 2 mm = 36.56 - 2 = 34.56 on the septal chart's upper edge; the top of the septal surface, no source gives it. Descent is a schematic line; the paper gives the entry, not the course.

s.anterior-ethmoidal-septal-branch.R.variable: Entry depends on the turbinate's axilla, which the specimen approximates with the turbinate head.
s.anterior-ethmoidal-septal-branch.R.derivation: Entry: A = A(lm.middle-turbinate-head.R) - 7.35 = -12.21 - 7.35 = -19.56 (Gras-Cabrerizo 2016, 7.35 mm behind the septal projection of the middle turbinate head, mean of 10 cavities); height: S = top(a) - 2 mm = 36.56 - 2 = 34.56 on the septal chart's upper edge; the top of the septal surface, no source gives it. Descent is a schematic line; the paper gives the entry, not the course.

s.nasopalatine-artery.L.variable: The incisive-canal end is the specimen's own canal (lm.incisive-canal.M); the artery's course to it is schematic.
s.nasopalatine-artery.L.derivation: End at the incisive canal: the septal chart cell nearest lm.incisive-canal.M (A -19.08), at the lowest occupied S of its column (S 0; the canal's own S is a lower bound, clipped by the box). Bleier 2011 and MacArthur 2016 are kept as sources for the artery's role (the pedicle's anterior supply), not for its position. The start continues the inferior branch; the course between is a straight chart segment, schematic.

s.posterior-septal-artery-inferior-branc.variable: Which branch is dominant, and where the artery divides, vary between sides and people (Zhang 2014: dominant inferior in 61.5%, division near the sphenopalatine foramen in 65.4%).
s.posterior-septal-artery-inferior-branc.derivation: Start: on the chart's posterior edge at S = S(lm.sphenoid-ostium.L) - 9.3 = 24.16 - 9.3 = 14.86 (m.psa-to-sphenoid-ostium: the artery lies 9.3 mm below the ostium; Pinheiro-Neto 2011), at the lowest occupied A of the cells either side of that S (A -45; the chart's posterior edge there). Course: down the posterior border, then anteroinferiorly (Zhang 2014); the straight chart segments between waypoints are schematic, not observed.

s.posterior-septal-artery-inferior-branc.variable: Which branch is dominant, and where the artery divides, vary between sides and people (Zhang 2014: dominant inferior in 61.5%, division near the sphenopalatine foramen in 65.4%).
s.posterior-septal-artery-inferior-branc.derivation: Start: on the chart's posterior edge at S = S(lm.sphenoid-ostium.R) - 9.3 = 24.16 - 9.3 = 14.86 (m.psa-to-sphenoid-ostium: the artery lies 9.3 mm below the ostium; Pinheiro-Neto 2011), at the lowest occupied A of the cells either side of that S (A -45; the chart's posterior edge there). Course: down the posterior border, then anteroinferiorly (Zhang 2014); the straight chart segments between waypoints are schematic, not observed.

s.posterior-septal-artery-superior-branc.variable: Course of the superior branch is not described in the sources read for this pass; it is drawn short, toward the upper septum.
s.posterior-septal-artery-superior-branc.derivation: Start: on the chart's posterior edge at S = S(lm.sphenoid-ostium.L) - 9.3 = 24.16 - 9.3 = 14.86 (m.psa-to-sphenoid-ostium: the artery lies 9.3 mm below the ostium; Pinheiro-Neto 2011), at the lowest occupied A of the cells either side of that S (A -45; the chart's posterior edge there). The direction (forward and up along the upper septum, ending about 10 mm below its top) is schematic and has no cited waypoint; verify before relying on it.

s.superior-labial-septal-branch.L.variable: Entry level at the columella varies; the specimen's face mask removed the entry.
s.superior-labial-septal-branch.L.derivation: Truncated: the artery enters at the columella and caudal septum, which the specimen's mask removed, so only an ascending segment along the anterior septal margin is drawn from the first on-chart point. ST6 (the external nose): the septal chart now ends at the internal valve plane, A -10, so the three waypoints that lay at A -9..-8 on the earlier chart (which reached A -3) are re-seated on that edge row with the same S: still the ascending segment along the anterior septal margin. The columella entry in front of the valve plane is not on the septal chart; ST4d / the checkpoint decides whether to draw it.
